player_prompt.intro:
Tikulandirani ku Lights Out! Mulina gridi ya {size}x{size} ya miyala.
Cholinga chanu ndi kuzima MIYALA YONSE (yomwe imawakilishidwa na '.').
Mukadikira miyala, imakhazikika yenyewe NDIPONSO abwenzi ake a pafupi (kunyamula/kutsika/kumanja/kumanzere).
Lembani [row col] kukodza miyala (0-indexed, kwa hivyo masafa abale ndi 0-{max_index}).
Mulina mpaka {max_turns} mizintho kutatua fumbo.
Maulalo: 'O' = miyala imawaka, '.' = miyala imazima

board.current_state:
Hali ya sasa ya gridi (Move {moves_made}, {moves_left} zidziwili ziliyobaki, {completion}% ikompletika):
{grid}

invalid_move.wrong_format: Action ayenera kukhala mu mtundu [row col] kumene mzere ndi col ndi integers kuchokera 0 kuti {max_index}.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Viwianishi vikuyenera kuwa pakati pa 0 ndi {max_index}. Mwalembera [{row},{col}].

outcome.win: Zabwino zonse! Mwathetsa vutoli mu {moves_used} mayendedwe!
